name: ZSF_FCST_PERIOD_ADJUSTMENT
description: This table stores the adjustment amount and subordinate adjustment amount for each period in corporate currency.

columns.name: FCST_PERIOD_ADJUSTMENT_ID
columns.description: Primary Key for the table  ZSF_FCST_PERIOD_ADJUSTMENT

columns.name: SUMADJ_QUANTITY
columns.description: The adjustment made to the Quantity field at the Product Aggregate leve;

columns.name: SUMADJ_SUB_QUANTITY
columns.description: The Subordinate adjustment made to the Quantity field at the Product Aggregate leve;

columns.name: FCST_ADJUST_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to the periods table namely ZSF_FCST_ADJUST_PERIOD

columns.name: BI_ADJUSTMENT_PERIOD_ID
columns.description: Same as FCST_ADJUST_PERIOD_ID for a territory adjustment, will be storing last adjusted period for a product adjustment that doesnt have time dimension.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: FCST_ADJUSTMENT_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to the summary table storing the adjustment details ZSF_FCST_ADJUSTMENT

columns.name: CORP_ADJUSTMENT_AMT
columns.description: The adjustment amount for each adjust period stored in corporate currency.

columns.name: CORP_SUB_ADJUST_AMT
columns.description: Adjustment amount done for the subordinate stored in corporate currency.

columns.name: FCST_PARTICIPANT_ID
columns.description: This has the foreign key reference to the forecast participant  table

columns.name: TERRITORY_ID
columns.description: This has the territory id denormalized and stored here.

columns.name: CHANNEL_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: This stores the channel type code, eg : Direct/ Indirect. This is used in summary adj metrics

columns.name: ADJUSTMENT_CATEGORY
columns.description: Adjustment category that corresponds to adjustments on a given forecast item category totals.

columns.name: FCST_PRODUCT_ID
columns.description: FK to the snapshot of product hierarchy stored in ZSF_FCST_PRODUCT

columns.name: CORP_BESTCASE_ADJUST_AMT
columns.description: The best case adjustment amount for each adjust period stored in corporate currency.

columns.name: CORP_SUB_BESTCASE_ADJUST_AMT
columns.description: The best adjustment amount for each adjust period stored in corporate currency for subordinate.

columns.name: CORP_WORSTCASE_ADJUST_AMT
columns.description: The worst case adjustment amount for each adjust period stored in corporate currency.

columns.name: CORP_SUB_WORSTCASE_ADJUST_AMT
columns.description: The worstcase adjustment amount for each adjust period stored in corporate currency for subordinate.

columns.name: CORP_SUB_PROD_ADJUST_AMT
columns.description: This stores the product level adjustment amount entered by subordinate

columns.name: CORP_SUB_PROD_BEST_ADJUST_AMT
columns.description: This stores the product level best case amount entered by subordinate

columns.name: CORP_SUB_PROD_WORST_ADJUST_AMT
columns.description: This stores the product level worst case amount entered by subordinate

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CONFLICT_ID
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: this value is used to guarantee the uniqueness of the row when duplicates are created in different databases (i.e. mobile databases or the server).

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: USER_LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Disconnected Mobile: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row. This value is different from LAST_UPDATE_DATE if the update originally happened in a different database (i.e. a different mobile database or the server).
